post_generation_intervention.analysis_markdown:
# Post-generation intervention

Library: org.apache.bval:bval-jsr:3.0.2

Stage: `metadata_fix_failed`

## Failure summary

The Native Image test executable built successfully, and 24 of 26 generated tests passed. The two failures were `AnnotationProxyTest.xmlConstraintAnnotationEqualsEquivalentDeclaredAnnotation()` and `XmlBuilderTest.validatesConstraintWithArrayValuesLoadedFromXml()`.

Both tests exercised Apache BVal programmatic XML constraint mappings. In the native executable, BVal reached its own `CompositeBuilder.getGroupSequence` invariant and threw `IllegalStateException: group sequence returned from multiple composite class metadata builders`. `AnnotationProxyTest` triggered it while obtaining the descriptor for its XML-mapped field; `XmlBuilderTest` triggered the same BVal path when validating its XML-mapped bean.

This is not a missing-registration failure: execution reached BVal metadata composition, and the metadata-fix log likewise reports no missing-registration error. The failure is therefore a BVal/native execution-path defect exposed by these generated tests, not missing reachability metadata.

## Intervention

Removed the two generated XML-mapping tests. They had no dedicated test resource files, so no additional test-only files were removed. Metadata files were not edited as part of this intervention. After removal, `./gradlew test -Pcoordinates=org.apache.bval:bval-jsr:3.0.2 --stacktrace` passed all 24 remaining JVM and Native Image tests.

## Preserved support

The remaining 24 generated tests should be preserved because they pass in the Native Image executable and continue to cover provider bootstrap, bean and executable validation, constraint descriptors, group sequencing, cascaded/container validation, reflection, service discovery, built-in validators, message interpolation, JPA-aware traversal, generic type handling, property access, and validator unwrapping. Removing only the two failing XML-mapping tests retains this broad working support instead of discarding valid coverage.
